about: The discovery change QA thresholds and word lists. scripts/change_preview.py reads this file, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; SKILL.md says how the findings turn into a verdict.

notes.page_size: Products on the first page. The preview compares the first page before and after the change, and 'pushed off page one' means out of this many.
notes.top_queries: How many of the affected queries (by revenue, then visits) get a grid preview and are listed in the report.
notes.top_seller_rank: A product in the top this-many rows of the product performance table (sorted by revenue) counts as a top seller; pushing one off page one is a warning.
notes.brand_share_warning: After a boost, a single brand holding at least this share of the first page is a warning (shoppers lose choice).
notes.hard_sort_strength: An attribute boost or bury at or above this strength (0-100) behaves like a hard sort; it's a nitpick, worth a second look.
notes.synonym_overlap_warning: For a synonym, the share of the target term's first results whose title shares a word with what the source term finds today (words in at least two of its titles). Below this, the expansion probably brings in different products: warning. When the source finds nothing, this can't be checked.
notes.synonym_sample: How many of the source and target terms' first results the synonym overlap check reads.
notes.broad_query_max_words: A phrase-match rule or redirect on a query with this many words or fewer matches many longer searches: warning.
notes.redirect_min_revenue: A redirect on a search, or that a phrase match would catch, earning at least this much revenue in the period takes those shoppers away from products: warning.
notes.stock_fields: Grid fields that may carry stock status. Ask for them in fl; fields the catalog doesn't have are dropped silently, and then stock isn't checked.
notes.out_of_stock_values: Values of a stock field that mean out of stock (compared lower-case). Boosting or pinning such a product onto page one is a warning.
notes.promo_words: Words in a rule's name that mark it as promotional. A promotional rule with no end date is a warning.
notes.placeholder_url_words: Text in a redirect URL's path or query that suggests it isn't finished (compared lower-case): blocker. The host is only checked for example.com.
notes.stop_words: Words ignored when comparing a query with product titles (relevance of pinned and boosted products, synonym overlap).
